sv.title: Edvin Anger har hittat vad som gick fel på OS
sv.summary: Edvin Anger kom till OS som ett stor svenskt hopp. Det slutade i fiasko, för både honom och det svenska herrlaget. Nu har han hittat vad som gick fel.

en.title: Edvin Anger has found what went wrong at the Olympics
en.summary: Edvin Anger came to the Olympics as a great Swedish hope. It ended in fiasco, for both him and the Swedish men's team. Now he has found what went wrong.
